ios.desc:
Hear a number in a foreign language. Know it instantly. That's the goal.

Foreign Numbers is a reference and training tool for mastering numbers in 26 languages. Look up how to say any number, hear it pronounced by a native speaker, then test yourself with the listening game until recognition becomes automatic.

WHAT YOU GET
— Number charts for 26 languages, with cardinal and ordinal forms
— Native audio for every number — tap to hear it spoken
— Listening game to train your ear at natural speed
— Phone number guides so you know how locals actually say them
— See the same number side-by-side across every language

PERFECT FOR
— Travelers who need to catch prices, floors, and phone numbers
— Language learners who want to close the gap between reading and hearing
— Anyone who keeps mishearing numbers in conversation

26 LANGUAGES
Arabic · Chinese · Czech · Danish · Dutch · Finnish · French · German · Greek · Hebrew · Hindi · Hungarian · Indonesian · Italian · Japanese · Korean · Norwegian · Polish · Portuguese · Romanian · Russian · Spanish · Swedish · Thai · Turkish

Free to download. Foreign Numbers Plus unlocks the full experience.
